name: Duskwalker — Additional Material (d20pfsrd)
body:
More on Duskwalker from d20pfsrd.com.

These sections appear on d20pfsrd.com's page "Duskwalker" but are not part of the Duskwalker entry, which is unchanged.

Born of an ancient pact between an olethros mother and a yamaraj, the duskwalkers are the honored dead, souls given the privilege of a single reincarnation. Each had once helped the cause of fate, preserving the cycle of souls by sword or pen, out of duty or kindness or fear. Each had seen his first life end too soon, a thread cut before its fated time. Now, they live again, watched by the psychopomps but free to forge new destinies.
